newsitem.title: UK: Nickel physicals stable, await 2Q interest.
newsitem.headline: Nickel physicals stable, await 2Q interest.

text.p: Nickel premiums are stable in Europe at present, with spot physical business ticking over ahead of the second quarter, traders said.
The stainless steel sector looks to be in good shape, with capacity higher than in the last quarter of 1996, while order books are believed to be healthy.
There is also said to be a shortage of stainless-steel scrap, which means that producers will have to depend on more primary nickel for feed, they said.
Plating grade nickel premiums remain around $310/tonne, while discounts for uncut Russian cathodes range from $50 to $80, with business recently around $70, they said.
